statement: principle: OAuth state, nonce, and handoff code are one-time and atomically consumed.
subject: Security Invariants

statement: principle: OIDC/JWKS verification is mandatory for identity.
subject: Security Invariants

statement: principle: HMAC verification uses raw query/body bytes and timing-safe compare.
subject: Security Invariants

statement: principle: Query/header orgid is never enough for webhook mutation.
subject: Security Invariants

statement: principle: Haravan tokens stay server-side and encrypted at rest.
subject: Security Invariants

statement: principle: App session cookies are HttpOnly; production cookies are Secure with explicit SameSite policy.
subject: Security Invariants

statement: principle: Unsafe cookie-authenticated routes enforce origin/referer validation and add CSRF token validation if cross-site cookies are required.
subject: Security Invariants

statement: principle: Uninstall clears Redis and DB token material and tombstones domains.
subject: Security Invariants

statement: principle: No production secret has a real default.
subject: Principles

statement: principle: Production starts fail closed when required OAuth/OIDC/session/DB/Redis values are missing.
subject: Principles

statement: principle: OIDC verification must not infer issuer/JWKS from untrusted callback data.
subject: Principles

statement: principle: Webhook verification must not run without a configured secret when webhook ingress is enabled.
subject: Principles

statement: principle: Body limits and rate limits are core ingress controls, not optional recipes.
subject: Principles

statement: principle: No jwt.decode() identity trust.
subject: Core Invariants

statement: principle: No direct no-HMAC session.
subject: Core Invariants

statement: principle: No JS-readable app session token in core.
subject: Core Invariants

statement: principle: No Redis KEYS in production paths.
subject: Core Invariants

statement: principle: No non-owner lock release.
subject: Core Invariants

statement: principle: No random webhook idempotency fallback.
subject: Core Invariants

statement: principle: No webhook state mutation before HMAC and org/domain cross-check.
subject: Core Invariants

statement: principle: No public readiness details.
subject: Core Invariants
